tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description: Create a hosted dashboard; returns its public URL. Dashboard spec: {"title": str, "description"?: str, "range"?: "1m"|"3m"|"6m"|"ytd"|"1y"|"2y"|"5y"|"10y"|"max", "theme"?: "auto"|"light"|"dark" (default mode; auto follows the viewer's system and viewers can switch), "layout"?: "auto"|"overview"|"det

tools.name: update_dashboard
tools.description: Replace a dashboard's spec (URL stays the same). Every update is saved as a numbered version. With "draft": true it is saved without going live: viewers keep seeing the live version, members can preview the draft at the returned preview_url, and publish_dashboard_version makes it live. Use drafts fo

tools.name: list_dashboard_versions
tools.description: List a dashboard's saved versions (newest first) with which one is live and a members-only preview URL for each.

tools.name: publish_dashboard_version
tools.description: Make a saved version of a dashboard the live one (also to roll back). The dashboard keeps its URL and visibility.

tools.name: rotate_dashboard_url
tools.description: Give a dashboard a new public URL and disable the old one at once (e.g. if a link leaked). Spec and data are unchanged.

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: List dashboards with their URLs.

tools.name: delete_dashboard
tools.description: Delete a dashboard (series data is kept).

tools.name: push_points
tools.description: Write dated values to a series (upsert by date). Use when you compute data yourself. Values are numbers, or short text labels for a text series (e.g. a rating or stance; see Data policy). A series' first write fixes its type.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: Read the latest points of a series.

tools.name: list_series
tools.description: List all series with their type (number or text), point counts and date ranges; text series also list their values.

tools.name: delete_series
tools.description: Delete all points of a series, or remove a derived series' definition.

tools.name: define_derived
tools.description: Create or replace a derived series, computed from other series every time it is read (always fresh, stores no points, counts toward the series limit). definition: {"op":"add"|"subtract"|"multiply"|"divide","a":series,"b":series} (matched by date) | {"op":"pct_change"|"diff"|"moving_average"|"rolling

tools.name: list_secrets
tools.description: List the names of the workspace's stored secrets (API keys for private sources) and the host each may be sent to. Use one in a job's url, headers or body as {{secret:NAME}}.

tools.name: test_job
tools.description:
Dry-run a job spec: fetch, extract and transform, return a preview. Saves nothing. Job spec: {"series": name, "cron": "m h dom mon dow" (UTC, at most every 5 min),
"request": {"url", "method"?: "GET"|"POST", "headers"?: {}, "body"?: obj|str,
            "pages"?: {"param": "page", "start"?: 0, "max"

tools.name: update_job
tools.description:
Replace a job's spec, or pause it with enabled=false. Job spec: {"series": name, "cron": "m h dom mon dow" (UTC, at most every 5 min),
"request": {"url", "method"?: "GET"|"POST", "headers"?: {}, "body"?: obj|str,
            "pages"?: {"param": "page", "start"?: 0, "max"?: 1-10} (json with items: bu

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List scheduled fetch jobs with their last run status and any error message.

tools.name: run_job_now
tools.description: Run a scheduled fetch job immediately, store any new points, and return the run result.

tools.name: delete_job
tools.description: Delete a job (its series data is kept).

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Health check: failing jobs, stale or empty panels, dashboards, storage usage. Call this to verify everything works.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Storage usage against quotas (data points = values + annotations, series, dashboards, jobs) and the largest series. Check before large writes.

tools.name: add_annotations
tools.description: Attach short dated notes to a series (e.g. 'Policy rate raised to 4.5%'); shown as markers on charts. Single-line plain text, max 280 chars; one note per date (re-adding replaces it); each counts as one data point.

tools.name: list_annotations
tools.description: Read the latest annotations of a series.

tools.name: delete_annotations
tools.description: Delete annotations of a series on the given dates, or all of them if dates is omitted.

tools.name: set_alert_webhook
tools.description: Set or clear the workspace webhook URL for job-failure and dashboard status alerts (pass an empty url to clear). When events fire, tlly POSTs JSON to that URL (Slack and Discord incoming webhooks get a short text payload instead). Events include job_failed, status_changed (keep panel "id" fields in

tools.name: set_panel_alert
tools.description: Set when one dashboard panel sends alert email and/or a webhook (colour change, threshold cross, or off). trigger: change (default), red, notgreen, above, below, or off; above/below need limit. notify: both, email, or webhook. panel is the 0-based index in the live spec. Saving can send immediately

tools.name: set_stale_alert
tools.description: Configure when tlly sends stale-data alert email and webhooks because a series stopped updating. after: auto (from the job schedule and point spacing, at least two days), off, hours, or a window like 48h or 7d. Use dashboard_id for every series on a dashboard, series for one series, or both for one

tools.name: list_integration_skills
tools.description: List integration setup playbooks (Stripe, Shopify, Sheets, and the other sources tlly can read). A spreadsheet starts from the KPI template. Make a copy https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Ty5X3LkY2unxTNGbkq36qDzuuYxQMsuywaTNyzL_pac/copy. Public CSV https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Ty5X3L

tools.name: get_integration_skill
tools.description: Read one integration playbook by id: what to track, the minimum credential and scopes, the exact tlly job, and gotchas. google-sheets and json-api also return a template field (Make a copy, public CSV, downloads). Make a copy https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Ty5X3LkY2unxTNGbkq36qDzuuYxQMsuywa

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_dashboard, update_dashboard, list_dashboard_versions, list_dashboards, list_secrets, test_job, create_job, import_once, update_job, list_jobs, set_alert_webhook, get_integration_skill · Private data: create_dashboard, update_dashboard, list_secrets, test_job, create_job, import_once, update_job, list_integration_skills, get_integration_skill · Public sink: update_dashboard, publish_dashboard_version, define_derived, test_job, create_job, import_once, update_job, set_alert_webhook, set_panel_alert, set_stale_alert · Destructive: delete_dashboard, delete_series, test_job, create_job, import_once, update_job, list_jobs, run_job_now, delete_job, delete_annotations, list_integration_skills, get_integration_skill.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_dashboard, update_dashboard, list_dashboard_versions, list_dashboards, list_secrets, test_job, create_job, import_once, update_job, list_jobs, set_alert_webhook, get_integration_skill · Private data: create_dashboard, update_dashboard, list_secrets, test_job, create_job, import_once, update_job, list_integration_skills, get_integration_skill · Public sink: update_dashboard, publish_dashboard_version, define_derived, test_job, create_job, import_once, update_job, set_alert_webhook, set_panel_alert, set_stale_alert · Destructive: delete_dashboard, delete_series, test_job, create_job, import_once, update_job, list_jobs, run_job_now, delete_job, delete_annotations, list_integration_skills, get_integration_skill

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
